name: Multiloca Lite – Multi Location Inventory Management for WooCommerce
author: Techspawn

sections.description:
Multiloca Lite is a WooCommerce multi-location product & inventory management plugin for multi-store and multi-warehouse shops. Manage product stock per location, display location-based availability on product pages, and support click-and-collect and in‑store pickup from your WooCommerce store.

Instead of keeping one global stock number, you can assign products to locations, enter separate stock quantities per location, and show live location-based availability on the product page. Customers see exactly where a product is in stock and can select the location they want before adding to cart.

It’s ideal for multi-location businesses such as retail chains, franchises, regional stores and warehouse-based shops that need accurate, location-based WooCommerce inventory and centralized stock control.

With Multiloca Lite, you get a clean, WooCommerce-native approach to multi location product and inventory management. Keep a single WooCommerce store while tracking stock across multiple physical locations (stores, warehouses, pickup points, regional centers) without complex ERPs or custom code.

Multiloca Lite is built specifically for WooCommerce multi-location inventory, follows WordPress coding standards, and is compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Looking for advanced features like automatic location assignment, per-location pricing or geolocation? Check out the Pro version on CodeCanyon:

  • Multiloca Pro – WooCommerce Multi Locations Inventory Management
  • More info, docs and demos: https://multiloca.co/

» Buy Multiloca Pro | » Demos & Features | » Docs

🔍 How Multiloca Lite Works in Your Store

  • Define physical locations such as stores, warehouses, retail outlets, pickup points and regional centers and link them to products.
  • Enter stock quantities per product per location instead of relying on a single global stock field.
  • Let customers see where items are in stock and choose their preferred store or warehouse before they add to cart.
  • Have orders automatically tagged with the selected location so stock is reduced and restored at the right place.

🎯 Multiloca Lite at a Glance

  • Built for WooCommerce multi-location inventory – Replace a single global stock value with per-location quantities for every product.
  • Transparent location-based availability – Show customers exactly where items are in stock before they add to cart.
  • Location-aware checkout & fulfillment – Keep orders tied to the right store or warehouse so your team always knows where to pick and pack.
  • Flexible layouts – Display multi-location stock as tables, lists, cards, expanded panels or simple text to match your theme.
  • HPOS-ready and standards-based – Works with WooCommerce HPOS and follows WordPress coding standards.

🧩 Core Features Included in This Free Version

  • Unlimited location management for multi-store setups – Create and manage unlimited business locations (stores, warehouses, pickup points, outlets, etc.) using a dedicated, hierarchical Locations taxonomy for WooCommerce products. Attach products to one or many locations for true multi-location product and inventory management.
  • Location-based inventory tracking with automatic totals – Store and maintain separate stock quantities per product for each location instead of one global stock number. WooCommerce stock is automatically calculated as the sum of all location stocks, and you can run a one-click maintenance tool to recalculate everything if needed.
  • Location availability on product pages – Add a Location Availability section to WooCommerce product pages that shows per-location inventory using table, list, card, expanded or simple text layouts.
  • Customer location selection before add to cart – Let shoppers choose their preferred store or warehouse location right on the product page. Requested quantities are validated against the selected location’s stock, helping prevent over‑selling.
  • Location-based order fulfillment & stock adjustments – Save the selected location on each order line item so staff know which store or warehouse should fulfill the order. Stock is reduced and restored at the correct location when orders move through statuses (completed, cancelled, failed, etc.).
  • Flexible display controls & design – Use the plugin’s settings to control which location fields (address, city, state, postcode, country, email, phone) show on the frontend and add custom CSS so the inventory block blends into your theme.
  • Developer and REST API friendly – Locations are stored as a standard WooCommerce product taxonomy, so multi-location inventory and location data can be accessed via the WordPress REST API for custom dashboards and integrations.

🔑 Why Multiloca Lite is a Great WooCommerce Multilocation Plugin

Many WooCommerce stores grow from a single warehouse to a network of stores, pickup points and regional hubs. Multiloca Lite adds a flexible WooCommerce multilocation inventory layer on top of your existing store so you can grow without changing platform.

  • WooCommerce multilocation inventory control – Keep separate stock per store, warehouse or pickup point while still working with a single WooCommerce catalog and checkout.
  • WooCommerce multilocation availability – Show customers where each product is available, so they always see accurate, location-based stock before ordering.
  • WooCommerce multilocation order routing – Use the selected location on each order to route fulfillment to the right team and keep operational workflows simple.

🚀 WooCommerce Multilocation Use Cases

  • Multi‑Store Retailers – Manage WooCommerce stock across all branches instead of one global inventory.
  • Warehouse‑Based Stores – Split inventory across multiple warehouses and ship from the right one.
  • Click & Collect / BOPIS – Let customers pick up orders from specific locations with accurate per‑location stock.
  • Franchise & Chain Stores – Separate inventory for each franchise or store and report per location.
  • Regional / Country Stores – Maintain regional stock pools and show availability per region.
  • Service & Rental Businesses – Track availability of services or rental items per location.

💼 What You Unlock with Multiloca Pro

If you run a growing multi-location WooCommerce store with dedicated operations or warehouse teams, Multiloca Pro builds on your existing setup and adds tools to automate and fine‑tune location-based inventory, pricing and fulfillment.

  • Advanced order routing & fulfillment rules – Automatically route orders to the best location based on customer or product location, define fulfillment priorities and use location‑specific shipping and payment methods. Advanced auto‑allocation and backorder controls help prevent overselling.
  • Geolocation and store finder – Auto‑detect customer location, surface the nearest locations with stock, and offer a map‑based store selector for multi‑store brands.
  • Location-based pricing and promotions – Configure different prices per location or region, run location‑specific discounts and promotions, and support flexible pricing strategies for franchises, regional and outlet stores.
  • Team roles and store‑level permissions – Give store managers or warehouse staff access only to their own locations, with dedicated roles and capabilities designed for multi‑store teams.
  • Analytics, reports and forecasting – Get detailed inventory, sales and profit reporting per location, plus dashboards that highlight high‑performing stores and low‑stock items to help you plan purchasing.
  • Shipping & POS friendly – Designed to work alongside major WooCommerce shipping plugins (including table‑rate, carrier and label/fulfillment tools) and popular WooCommerce POS systems, so online and in‑store inventory stay in sync.
  • Drop‑in upgrade from this free version – Pro uses the same locations and stock data as this plugin. Install it, activate your license, and instantly extend your existing multi‑location inventory without re‑entering data.

Get Multiloca Pro →

🌟 Premium Enterprise Features

Multiloca Premium offers enterprise-grade capabilities for large retail chains, franchise networks and businesses with complex warehouse and purchasing workflows:

🤖 Automated Fulfillment
* Rule-based automatic location assignment
* Advanced order routing algorithms
* Smart inventory allocation systems

📋 Vendor & Purchase Order Management
* Create and manage vendor relationships
* Generate purchase orders automatically
* Track supplier performance and costs

🔄 Stock Transfer Management
* Initiate transfers between locations
* Track transfer status and history
* Automated rebalancing suggestions

🔗 Third-Party Integrations
* ERP system connections
* Accounting software integration
* Advanced API endpoints

Need Help Getting Started?

  • 📖 Read our Quick Start Guide & Docs
  • 💬 Free users: use the WordPress.org support forum for Multiloca Lite
  • 💼 Pro & enterprise users: open a support ticket at https://multiloca.co/support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/multiloca-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. In the WordPress admin, go to Products → Locations to create your locations (stores, warehouses, pickup points, etc.).
  4. Edit your WooCommerce products and assign them to one or more locations, then set stock levels per location.
  5. Configure display options and behaviour under Multiloca Lite → Settings.
  6. Visit a product page to confirm that the Location Availability box shows and that customers can see multi‑location stock.
sections.faq:
Is this a WooCommerce multilocation plugin?

Yes. Multiloca Lite is designed specifically as a WooCommerce multilocation solution. It adds per-location stock, location availability on product pages and location-aware order handling on top of a single WooCommerce store, so you can manage multi-store and multi-warehouse inventory from one dashboard.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, Multiloca Lite requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

How many locations can I create?

You can create and manage unlimited locations in both the lite and pro versions.

Can customers choose which location to buy from?

Yes. Customers can select their preferred location on the product page in the location availability block before adding to cart. The selected location is stored with the order so you can fulfill from the correct store or warehouse.

Can I use this for WooCommerce multi‑warehouse inventory?

Yes. Each warehouse can be a location. You can assign products to multiple warehouses, manage stock per warehouse and display availability per warehouse on the product page.

Is this suitable for click and collect / in‑store pickup?

Yes. Create locations for each pickup store, assign products and manage per‑store stock. Customers see which store has stock and can select their preferred pickup location when adding to cart.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Multiloca Lite is designed to work with any well-coded WooCommerce-compatible theme. The plugin uses standard WooCommerce hooks and follows WordPress coding standards for maximum compatibility.

Can I display location information on product pages?

Yes, location inventory displays automatically on product pages once you assign locations and stock. You can choose different display views (table, list, card, expanded, simple text) from the settings.

Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS (High‑Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Multiloca Lite declares compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS and works with the new order storage system.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin doesn’t collect any personal customer data beyond what WooCommerce already handles. All data processing follows WordPress and WooCommerce privacy standards.
